parts: I am new to ggplot. I have a vector of data points and would like to color them in the scatter plot I have. How can i color only those points

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: coloring individual data points in ggplot
parts:
Saba, you'll want to have a field in your data frame that signals to
ggplot the points should have a different color. For example:

> d <- data.frame(x=1:5,y=1:5,colorme=c(F,F,T,F,F))
> qplot(x,y,color=colorme,data=d)

Ben
